select h.household_id, h.site_id, h.dong, h.ho, h.head_name, h.target_type, h.install_status, h.remarks, h.create_time, wr.report_id, wr.status as report_status, wr.user_id as report_user_id, wr.reporter_name, date_format(wr.report_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as report_time from household h left join work_report wr on h.household_id = wr.household_id and wr.delete_flg = 0 where h.site_id = #{siteId,jdbcType=CHAR} order by h.dong asc, cast(h.ho as unsigned) asc, h.ho asc
